articles.title: Teenager Mika Stojsavljevic Claims First WTA Tour Win
articles.summary: Seventeen-year-old Mika Stojsavljevic, told just an hour before play, beat former Australian Open champion Sofia Kenin for her first WTA Tour main-draw win.

articles.title: A Manhole Cover Comedy Wins Top Prize at Tokyo Film Festival
articles.summary: "Sister Brother Manhole Cover," a comedy about siblings who steal manhole covers, won the top prize at the Tokyo International Film Festival.

articles.title: Movie Studios Promote Films by Just Giving Away Money
articles.summary: Two movie studios promoted their November 13 releases by giving away cash — a $100 ATM for "How to Rob a Bank" and a one-cent Venmo account for "Ebenezer."
